Name: SpacePrincess' Onesies (Pajamas) 1.6 Update
Author: wind0nd
Description:
[size=5][b]SpacePrincess' Onesies — 1.6 update[/b][/size]

An unofficial compatibility update of [b]SpacePrincess' Onesies[/b], converted from JsonAssets to Content Patcher so it works on Stardew Valley 1.6+.

[b]All artwork is the original author's[/b] — I only rewrote how the items are registered. No sprite was redrawn; the only texture edits are technical (see Changelog): shirt sheets widened to 256px so 1.6's dye-mask layer has somewhere to read, the missing female half of the pants sheets filled in, and a light shading pass on the coloured onesies so they don't read flat at 1.6 sizes.

[line]

[size=4][b]What's inside[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]7 animals[/b] — Bear, Blue Chicken, Dog, Elephant, Kitty, Panda Bear, Unicorn[/*]
[*]Each animal has a [b]hat, shirt and pants[/b] — 21 items total[/*]
[*]4-frame walk animation preserved (the frames are the original art, so hats and shirts still "swing" as you walk)[/*]
[*]Sold at [b]Marnie's Animal Shop[/b] for 1000g each[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[/list][b]No longer needs[/b] JsonAssets or SpaceCore — that is the whole point of this update.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Drop the `[CP] SpacePrincess' Onesies (Pajamas)` folder into your `Mods` folder.[/*]
[*]If you still have the old JsonAssets version installed, [b]remove it first[/b] (the two would register duplicate items).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Upgrading from the old version[/b][/size]
The old JsonAssets items had runtime-generated IDs, so they cannot be carried over. Take off (or sell) any old onesie before you swap mods — your new ones will be waiting at Marnie's.

[list]
[*][b]SpacePrincesss[/b] — original mod, all sprites and item concepts: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5232]SpacePrincess' Onesies[/url][/*]

[/list]
[size=4][b]Permission[/b][/size]
Published with the original author's explicit permission. All credit for the art belongs to SpacePrincesss; if she ever wants to take over this page, just say the word.

[size=4][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
Found something off — a missing item, a broken sprite, a hair/hat glitch? Please tell me in the comments and I'll fix it. If anything about this page or the pack feels wrong, I'd rather hear it than not.

[size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]1.0.0[/b] — First release. Ported 21 items from JsonAssets to Content Patcher; corrected the `CanChooseDuringCharacterCustomization` field name; dropped the unsupported female-variant fields (the male/female sprites were identical anyway); restored the original item names and descriptions; shirt sheets widened to 256px (1.6 reads a dye-mask layer at x+128); female half of the pants sheets filled in; light shading pass on the coloured onesies only (Kitty and Panda untouched).
